title: Infused Crystal Grindstone
text: Upgrade a crystal grindstone using the same advanced assembly layout. Damaged equipment inside repairs one durability every five seconds.
With one input, choose which enchantments to keep or remove; all are kept initially. Taking the result costs 100 mana per removed enchantment, or 500 per curse, with no experience gained.
Two inputs disable enchantment selection. Matching equipment can only combine into an unenchanted repaired item. Both stored inputs still receive passive repairs.
